comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Rank Tech: 1
Consumed Gauge: 30
Range: 100
Scatter Range: 45

Requires 2 seconds before the activation.
With advanture job it will take 1 second before the activation.

Effect:
Aside from damage, the target(s) get paralyzed for at least 10 seconds. Higher Trap prolongs the effect. When attacking the target, who is paralyzed, the effect gets shorten!
